description:
OEDRO floor mats custom precision fit liners made from 3D laser scans of the interior area of your vehicle. It is a low-density strong flexible material that allows for easy installation and removal and keeps its shapes for life.
Features
Durability. All-climate floor mats are produced using TPE which makes them last more than different sorts of mats. The material is tough, yet adaptable, permitting it to withstand mileage. They will likewise withstand steady contact and scouring of shoes.
Trap dampness and soil. The floor mat surface is waterproof, permitting it to trap spillage. All-climate floor liners additionally adequately trap dry particles like sand and residue.
TPE Construction. OEDRO floor mats are made of TPE. This material is strong and durable, yet flexible even in extreme cold, as well as non-toxic, fire-resistant, UV-resistant, environmentally friendly, and odorless, so your interior won’t take on an unpleasant smell.
Superior Comfort and Liner Retention. Air pockets created during the injection molding process provide a cushioning and sound-deadening effect for greater driving comfort. The ridges that form the pockets grip the carpet, so the floor mats stay firmly in place.
Easy Clean-Up. When OEDRO floor mats get dirty, remove them from the vehicle, hose off the muck, allow them to dry, and reinstall.
2-years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
